description: This Mendeley Data release contains numerical features extracted from all-sky images together with measured global solar irradiance. The research team describes one-minute resolution over 2014–2016 and provides the deposit freely under CC BY 4.0. It derives features from an existing solar-forecasting dataset and is intended to benchmark artificial-intelligence forecasts for PV applications. The time series can support short-horizon generation simulations and comparisons of image-derived predictors. Its repository description still calls version 1 a sample awaiting manuscript review, so completeness remains uncertain and should be checked before assuming all three years are present. The geographic setting and file formats are not stated in the inspected metadata. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
